'''Wes Hogaan''' was a farmhand working at the [[Tanner Ranch]] in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Wes was married to [[Dana Hogaan|Dana]] and they had a daughter, [[Minda Hogaan|Minda]]. The Hogaans were forced to relocate to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] in the face of a marauding force of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
